# Nischal Nikit

> Personal portfolio of Nischal Nikit - software engineer building for the web. Essays and work history.

## About

Nischal Nikit builds things that live on the web. This site is his corner of the internet: work history and technical writing.

- Site: https://www.nischalnikit.xyz
- Blog: https://blog.nischalnikit.xyz
- GitHub: https://github.com/niiischall
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/niiischall

Contact: email and social links are in the footer of every page.

## Writing

Full articles are published at https://blog.nischalnikit.xyz. The portfolio writing page highlights selected posts with summaries and links.
